notes: Prices only: Elections Canada publishes no count over time (its election-night site keeps only the latest state), so there is no count timeline and no model; accuracy and profit cannot be measured.

Prices: Polymarket 1-minute price history (YES token), 2025-04-28T22:00:00Z to 2025-04-29T16:00:00Z (18:00 to 12:00 ET); a row is written only when the price changes (plus the last minute). Settled = price of the eventual outcome >= 0.9 from then to the end of the window.
Polls closed from 2025-04-28T23:00:00Z (Newfoundland) to 2025-04-29T02:00:00Z (British Columbia, Yukon).

Races: each Polymarket question is its own two-way race, A = YES. Provinces: the 'most seats' markets for the Liberals and their main rival (Conservatives; Bloc Québécois in Quebec). Margin events: the winning band only.

Map: one final frame (its time is the end of the price window; the official results were published later). Colour = Liberal share of the Liberal + Conservative vote in the official 2025 results; prior = the same share in Elections Canada's transposition of the 2021 vote onto the 2023 districts. Units: 'winner' (party id, see parties) and 'margin' (winner minus runner-up, points of valid votes x10) are top-level arrays; frame extra 'swing' = change in Liberal two-way share x1000.
Result: Liberals 169 seats, Conservatives 144, Bloc 22, NDP 7, Green 1 (Official Voting Results, Table 12).
Already settled when the price window opened (18:00 ET, before polls closed): ab-most-lpc, ab-most-cpc, sk-most-lpc, sk-most-cpc, pe-most-lpc, pe-most-cpc.
Not settled by the end of the window: seatmargin-lpc-25-49 (YES at 0.63 at 12:00 ET).

Official timing, coarse: the first archived capture of Elections Canada's national page after all polls closed is stamped 'Last updated' 2025-04-29T04:43:00Z (65,020 of 75,482 polls reporting, Liberals 163 leading or elected, Conservatives 149); the one before it is stamped 2025-04-29T00:21:00Z. Polymarket's 'Liberals win the most seats' market settled at 2025-04-29T02:00:00Z. Captures are hours apart, so this bounds when the official page showed the result; it does not date it.

kalshi = Kalshi P(candidate a) from 1-minute candles: bid/ask midpoint when the spread is at most 10¢, else the last trade; YES = b markets are inverted. Prices © Kalshi, shown as derived charts with credit.
